Event: Calworth offsite.
Date: Monday.
Schedule: Morning stand-up moved to garden studio. Afternoon stand-up in print room. Evening stand-up in harbour room.
Room Preferences/Constraints: Ada prefers library annex for reviews. Wren prefers print room for reviews. Una thinks print room too cold evening; Kira thinks harbour room too cold evening. Opal, Una, Hugo want print room, loading bay, and library annex kept clear for visitors respectively. Dell now wants harbour room kept clear for visitors.
Repainting Noise: Garden studio (afternoon), Loading bay (afternoon), Print room (morning), East wing (morning).
Facilities/Notes: Umbrella in garden studio (again). North office free afternoon; coffee working. Lift near north office slow. Lift near east wing slow. East wing coffee working. Esme asked about garden studio afternoon availability.
Personnel: Una, Opal, Bram (out; Rafe covering), Wren (swapping with Teo; thinks loading bay cold afternoon), Kira, Nils (swapping with Una), Mira, Esme, Jonah, Teo (covering for Leon; swapping with Wren), Leon (out).
Tasks: Send Opal morning meeting notes. Send Dell afternoon meeting notes. Send Una afternoon meeting notes.
